description: Defines the HpackBlockCollector class used for testing HPACK block decoding in HTTP/2, including methods for collecting, comparing, and serializing HPACK entries.

classes.name: HpackBlockCollector
classes.description: A class implementing HpackEntryDecoderListener for testing HPACK block decoding, collecting entries, and providing comparison and serialization functionalities.
